title: 第3章 父母归家静心摄念第4章 黄巾力士修士证
content_zh:
家里突逢大变之后，陆父陆母还是第一次如此高兴。
两人隔着手机屏幕，关切地询问陆羽成为地仙的细节。
陆羽避重就轻，简单地说了说整个手术的过程，尽挑些好听的说给他们听。
至于其中的危险与代价，就没有必要说出来让父母担心的了。
陆父陆母听得满脸笑容，自豪不已。
他们老陆家，终于是出了个仙师，也算是光宗耀祖，光耀门楣了。
分享完踏入仙途的喜悦，陆羽也说出自己的打算：
“爸妈，我想了想，你们还是先回来吧。我踏入仙途后，基本上就算是地仙管理局的人了，往后要给管理局做事出任务，还要修行，到时候恐怕没精力照顾弟弟了。”
想要救弟弟，陆羽少不了埋头苦修，大肝熟练度。
未来甚至还要探索青铜镜的时空门连通的异界，身边必须要有人帮衬。
“都听你的，都听你的！我们过会就找工厂老板辞职，收拾一下，马上回来！”
陆父陆母点点头，没有反驳。
他们知道成为仙师的陆羽已经真正长大。
这个家，以后该由他做主了。
他们再能忙，也只忙出了一套龙舒城的房子，忙出几十万存款。
在普通人群体中或许算是不错的，能维持温饱，可跟仙师一比，一个天上，一个地下。
挂断电话，陆父陆母不顾天色已黑，立刻给干活的工厂老板打去电话。
“徐总，我儿子踏入仙途，小儿子有救了！我们要辞职回家！”
正在家里休息的徐总听见陆父的声音眉头一皱，暗自纳闷。
“陆家两口子竟然这么好运？他儿子不是都二十多了么，怎么还能踏入仙途？”

有修仙天赋的人，上学的时候，都会被帝国的学校体检检查出来，然后收入专门的学校，特殊培养。
怎么可能会有二十多岁的漏网之鱼。
徐总想不明白，但这事宁可信其有，不可信其无。
一入仙途，便与普通人不在一个层面。
一人成仙，鸡犬升天，莫过于此。
于是，他连忙笑着恭贺陆父，同时旁敲侧击打听缘由。
陆父也没有隐瞒，简单的说了一下。
听说陆羽是靠速成地仙法手术踏上仙途，徐总也是一惊，暗道陆羽好运，心中对陆父也多了几分重视。
这事他也听过，也曾畅想过。
但速成法手术的高死亡率与高代价，还是劝退了他。
他家业有成，万万不会像普通人一样，拿性命去搏那一丝登仙机会。
“哼，成仙也不一定有我当老板自在！”
徐总心里酸溜溜地嘀咕着。
身体却很诚实，连夜帮陆父陆母办理了离职手续。
不但没有扣除突然离职的工钱，还多发了整月工资，甚至好心包了一个大红包，算是给陆杰的一点心意。
等到第二天天明，陆父陆母已经坐上最早一班高铁，踏上了回家的路。
content_en:
After the sudden change in the family, Father Lu and Mother Lu were so happy for the first time.
The two of them asked Lu Yu with concern about the details of becoming an Earth Immortal across the screen of their mobile phones.
Lu Yu avoided the important things and briefly explained the entire operation process, choosing some pleasant things to say to them.
As for the dangers and costs involved, there is no need to tell your parents about it.
Father Lu and Mother Lu were all smiles and proud after hearing this.
The old Lu family finally had an immortal master, and they could be regarded as a glorious ancestor and a glorious lintel.
After sharing the joy of embarking on the path to immortality, Lu Yu also expressed his plans:
"Mom and Dad, I've thought about it and you'd better come back first. After I step onto the path of immortality, I will basically be considered a member of the Earthly Immortal Bureau. In the future, I will have to do tasks for the Bureau and practice. I'm afraid I won't have the energy to take care of my brother by then."
In order to save his younger brother, Lu Yu had to practice hard and gain great proficiency.
In the future, we will even explore another world connected by the bronze mirror's time and space gate, and we must have someone around to help.
"I'll listen to you, I'll listen to you! We'll ask the factory boss to resign in a while, clean up the business, and come back right away!"
Father Lu and Mother Lu nodded without refuting.
They knew that Lu Yu, who had become an immortal master, had truly grown up.
From now on, it will be up to him to take charge of this family.
No matter how busy they were, they could only build a house in Longshu City and save hundreds of thousands in savings.
Among the ordinary people, it may be considered good, and they can maintain food and clothing, but compared with the immortal masters, one is in the sky and the other is on the earth.
After hanging up the phone, Father Lu and Mother Lu immediately called the factory owner who was working, regardless of the darkness.
"Mr. Xu, my son has entered the path of immortality. The younger son is saved! We have to resign and go home!"
Mr. Xu, who was resting at home, frowned when he heard Father Lu's voice and secretly wondered.
"How come the Lu family is so lucky? His son is already in his twenties, isn't he? How can he still enter the path of immortality?"
People who have the talent to cultivate immortality will be detected by the empire's school physical examination when they go to school, and then they will be admitted to a specialized school for special training.
How could someone in their twenties slip through the cracks?
Mr. Xu couldn't understand it, but he would rather believe that it happened than not.
Once you enter the path of immortality, you are no longer on the same level as ordinary people.
A person becomes an immortal, a chicken or a dog ascends to heaven, nothing better than this.
So, he quickly congratulated Lu's father with a smile, and at the same time made some insinuations to find out the reason.
Father Lu didn't hide anything and simply said it.
Hearing that Lu Yu had embarked on the path to immortality by means of a quick Earth Immortal Surgery, Mr. Xu was also shocked. He secretly thought that Lu Yu was lucky, and he also paid more attention to Lu's father.
He had also heard about this and had thought about it.
However, the high mortality rate and high cost of quick-fix surgery still dissuaded him.
His family is successful and he would never risk his life for a chance to become an immortal like ordinary people.
"Huh, even if you become an immortal, you may not be as comfortable as me being your boss!"
Mr. Xu muttered sourly in his heart.
But his body was very honest, and he helped Lu's father and Lu's mother go through the resignation procedures overnight.
Not only was the salary for the sudden resignation not deducted, but he was also given an extra month's salary, and was even kindly given a big red envelope as a token of appreciation for Lu Jie.
By dawn the next day, Lu's father and mother had already boarded the earliest high-speed train and embarked on their way home.
